observations.location: left facade and roof at middle left; right overhanging roof and facade
observations.observation: Opaque umber and slate masses use directional brush marks with rough dry gaps and firm overlapping boundaries. Roof profiles crop strongly at the left and upper-right edges.
A close upward view between differing roof heights gives a continuous bent sky corridor; warm yellow left window, suspended cream cloth at right, and crossing wire provide inhabited street traces.
Buildings, overhangs and wire form the scene and occupy substantial cropped area. They establish the upward urban observation rather than serve as a small appended ornament.

Painted building edges, depth and the wire/cloth define the sky opening carrying the two text groups. The image visibly organizes the composition; there is no isolated small image on a passive solid headline board.

format.observed: One flat rectangular opaque-looking poster; no mockup, comparison panels, frame, visible logo, QR or watermark.

observations.observation: Heavy serif title has broad interior counters, strong vertical strokes and restrained endings; two coherent lines and clear word separation.
All four body lines use consistent normal-width letterforms, stable baseline and moderate weight. Commas and sentence periods are distinct. No squeezed last-line fragment or isolated punctuation.

observations.location: upper title, central wire and lower paragraph
observations.observation: Large dark title is the typographic anchor; the roof and downward wire lead through the continuous sky to the lower paragraph.
The full body is a single four-line left-aligned paragraph with visible line spacing and ample contrast, without a separate information box.

function_contact.observation: No contact, URL, QR, hand interaction or functional mechanism requested.

observations.location: left warm window, middle wire, right cloth
observations.observation: Window remains nested in the wall; wire continues between opposite building edges; cloth folds retain a connected silhouette and hangs by a line. Dry gaps and varied short paint edges occur within the opaque illustration, while text stays clean.

residuals.location: lower facades, foliage and roof rail at lower right
residuals.observation: Small paint flecks, leaf marks and balcony rail details remain finer and more numerous than the main wide roof/wall strokes.
The body becomes small at the 213 × 320 thumbnail; complete reading was checked on the 720 × 1080 usage view.

selection_reason: Retain the inspected initial stage: exact observed copy, comfortable usage720 paragraph, clear title hierarchy and substantive upward urban painting are present. Finer lower-scene details do not justify disturbing the established reading and inhabited sky corridor.
